name: medrec
description: Read-only access to your household's medical records folder, kept by the open-source medrec CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about the medical records medrec keeps for your household: who takes what, conditions and allergies, immunizations, a lab test over time with each lab's reference range, visits, claims and bills, and the text of any filed document. Four read-only tools, medrec_summary, medrec_search, medrec_records and medrec_document; nothing can change the folder. The tools read the records folder of one medrec profile on this computer, so first install the medrec CLI and set up a profile (`medrec profiles add`, `medrec init`), then enter that profile's name here. A records folder on Google Drive is read through rclone, which must be installed and configured; the extension looks for it in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and /usr/bin. What the tools return goes to Claude.

profile.title: medrec profile
profile.description: The medrec profile whose records folder Claude reads. `medrec profiles list` shows them.

tools.name: medrec_summary
tools.description: The household's people, and one person's current medicines, conditions, allergies, immunizations, latest results, recent visits and bills due.

tools.name: medrec_search
tools.description: Documents, records, studies and notes holding every word of a query; a query naming lab tests (blood tests, labs) also finds every lab result, report and lab claim.

tools.name: medrec_records
tools.description: One kind of record, newest first: medications, conditions, allergies, immunizations, visits, procedures, results (one test over time), tests (the latest of each), reports, claims, coverage, bills, documents, notes or the timeline.

tools.name: medrec_document
tools.description: A filed document's extracted text, in parts.
